originalSource:
rem Almost Right-angled Triangles I
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=223
rem Count the integer triangles with
rem a <= b <= c, a^2 + b^2 = c^2 + 1 and
rem perimeter at most Limit

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option Limit integer = 25000000

rem All solutions hang from (1, 1, 1)
rem and (1, 2, 2) in two ternary trees
rem whose three maps keep a^2 + b^2 -
rem c^2. The tree of (1, 1, 1) is its
rem own mirror image (a <-> b), so it
rem has two triangles for each pair a !=
rem b and one for a = b. The other tree
rem has one for each pair. The first map
rem takes (1, b, b) to (1, b + 2, b +
rem 2), a chain too long for the levels,
rem so its triangles are counted and the
rem other two children are the start of
rem the levels, taken at once with the
rem triangles that are too long dropped.
Answer = 0
Cb = (Limit - 1) // 2
Wd = 2000000
for Root in 1 to 2
  Cnt = 0
  Same = 0
  if Root equal 1
    Same = 1
  end
  for Lo in Root to Cb by Wd
    Hi = Lo + Wd - 2
    if Hi greater Cb
      Hi = Cb
    end
    B1 = Lo to Hi by 2 array
    Cnt += B1 len
    A2' = 4 * B1 + 1
    B2' = 3 * B1 + 2
    C2' = 5 * B1 + 2
    A3' = 4 * B1 - 1
    B3' = 3 * B1 - 2
    C3' = 5 * B1 - 2
    A = concat A2 A3 copy
    B = concat B2 B3 copy
    C = concat C2 C3 copy
    for
      Per' = A + B + C
      Fit = Per at most Limit
      A = A filter Fit array
      B = B filter Fit array
      C = C filter Fit array
      if A len equal 0
        break
      end
      Cnt += A len
      Same += (A equal B) count
      Ta = 2 * A
      Tb = 2 * B
      Tc = 2 * C
      Tc3 = Tc + C
      Up = A + Tc
      Dn' = Tc - A
      Wp = B + Tc
      Wm' = Tc - B
      Df = Ta - Tb
      Sm' = Ta + Tb
      A1' = Up - Tb
      A2' = Up + Tb
      A3' = Dn + Tb
      B1' = Ta + Wm
      B2' = Ta + Wp
      B3' = Wp - Ta
      C1' = Tc3 + Df
      C2' = Tc3 + Sm
      C3' = Tc3 - Df
      A = concat A1 A2 A3 copy
      B = concat B1 B2 B3 copy
      C = concat C1 C2 C3 copy
    end
  end
  if Root equal 1
    Answer += (Cnt + Same) // 2
  else
    Answer += Cnt
  end
end
Answer print
